Class bear5

java.lang.Object
characters.bear5
All Implemented Interfaces:
Combatant
public class bear5 extends Object implements Combatant
The player character: health, power, money, location, inventory, party, learned moves, and active statuses.

Items, party members, and moves are stored by id (a String), not as objects, so the whole player can be turned into plain data with toSaveData() and rebuilt with fromSaveData(SaveData).

Invalid arguments (negative amounts, null ids) throw IllegalArgumentException. Ordinary game outcomes, such as not having enough money, return false instead.
